dct_title_s: Nieuwe Pascaert van Oost Indien Verthoonende hen van C. de Bona Esperanca tot aen het Landt van Eſo. Geleyt op Waßende Graeden en van Veel Fouten Verbetert
dct_description_sm: Two cartouches are shown on this map. The cartouche at the top is similar to Otten's map (see NOR 0252). The second cartouche provides the name and address of the author and is surrounded by dolphins and European traders. Two compass roses radiate rhumb lines.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997. Map 0267, p. 304.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0267.
